ShortDescription.Value: In-game SVG drawing overlay for road, zone, and transit planning before you build.

Publish.LongDescription:
## Skyplan
Tracing paper over your city inside CS2.
Open the overlay with **Alt+P** (rebindable), sketch out your road network, zoning, and transit lines on top of the live map, then build with confidence.
Left-Click to start drawing, Right-Click to end the drawing.
For lines, left-click starts a new segment from the end of the previous one.
For polygons, left-click adds a point and right-click closes the shape.
For Annotation, a small circle preview will be shown on the map where you clicked, a text field will show in the toolbar to write the text, then press **Enter** and the text will appear on the map.
### Disclaimer
This is a rough beta version, a lot of the feedback that i got on reddit is not yet implemented. even the Thumbnail is under development.
There is no auto-save nor auto load. please export the plans before closing the game.
The next minor beta version (milestone) will include:
v0.1.1:
* Redo support * Fuzzy search for layers in the toolbar * Performanc improvment
### Features
* Line, polygon, point and annotation drawing tools: plan roads, mark zones, drop points of interest * 24 built-in layers: Transit (Train, Subway, Tram, Bus), Roads (Highway to Local), Zones (Residential, Commercial, Industrial, Office), Public Services, and Points of Interest — each with its own colour and style * Fully customisable layers: edit `layers.json` to add, remove, or restyle any layer. Changes hot-swap without a game restart * World-space coordinates: shapes stay pinned to the map as you pan and zoom * SVG export and import: save your plans as standard SVG files, open them in Inkscape, share them, or import them back later * Erase tool: with hover highlight * Undo: (Ctrl+Z) * Draggable toolbar * Shape Manager: view all shapes grouped by layer, edit the name and description of each shape, toggle layer visibility and label display * Canvas labels: shape names can be toggled to appear on the map at the shape's anchor point * Visual: global and per-layer opacity sliders * Per-layer visibility toggle
## Known Issues
* changing the styles in `layers.json` while already having shapes in the current session wont hot reload. it needs clear-all for the new style to take effect.
## Limitations
* No redo, only undo (Ctrl+Z) is supported. * No snapping, lines do not snap to roads, the grid, or other shapes. * Each line is a separate two-point segment, continuous polylines are planned but not yet implemented.
### Usage
Load a city, press **Alt+P**, draw.
Publish.ChangeLog: ## 0.1.0-beta - Added: Labeling system: Annotation tool. Every shape has a title and description. - Added: Layer merge system: user customisations in layers.json are merged with the shipped defaults. New default layers appear automatically on update without overwriting your changes. - Added: Hover highlight: hovering a shape row in the Shape Manager highlights the shape on the map. - Visual enhancements: - Global opacity and per-layer opacity sliders. - Layer visibility toggle (eye icon per layer). - Label eye-toggle per layer (show/hide shape names on the canvas). - Global description visibility toggle. - Shapes grouped per layer in the SVG for correct stacking and opacity behaviour.
